description.en: Keeps only the odd-numbered selections (1st, 3rd, 5th…) in document order (warns when there is only one selection).
description.ja: 複数選択のうち文書順で奇数番目（1・3・5…）だけを残す（選択が 1 個なら警告）

description.en: Keeps only the even-numbered selections (2nd, 4th, 6th…) in document order (warns when there is only one selection).
description.ja: 複数選択のうち文書順で偶数番目（2・4・6…）だけを残す（選択が 1 個なら警告）

description.en: Asks for N (1–1,000,000) and keeps only the Nth, 2Nth, 3Nth… selections in document order (warns when there is no Nth selection).
description.ja: N（1〜1,000,000）を入力し、文書順で N・2N・3N… 番目の選択だけを残す（N 番目がなければ警告）

description.en: Removes the first selection in document order.
description.ja: 文書順で最初の選択を外す

description.en: Removes the last selection in document order.
description.ja: 文書順で最後の選択を外す

description.en: Keeps only the selections that match the regex you type (`u` flag, case-sensitive, up to 500 characters). Runs in a worker with a 2-second timeout (up to 10,000,000 selected characters in total).
description.ja: 入力した正規表現（`u` フラグ・大文字小文字を区別・最大 500 文字）に一致する選択だけを残す。ワーカーで実行し 2 秒で打ち切る（選択の合計 10,000,000 文字まで）

description.en: Removes the selections that match the regex you type (`u` flag, case-sensitive, up to 500 characters). Runs in a worker with a 2-second timeout (up to 10,000,000 selected characters in total).
description.ja: 入力した正規表現（`u` フラグ・大文字小文字を区別・最大 500 文字）に一致する選択を外す。ワーカーで実行し 2 秒で打ち切る（選択の合計 10,000,000 文字まで）

description.en: Removes empty selections (cursors only).
description.ja: 空の選択（カーソルのみ）を外す

description.en: Deselects duplicate texts: when several selections have the same text (case-sensitive), keeps only the first one in document order.
description.ja: 同じテキスト（大文字小文字を区別）の選択が複数あれば文書順で最初の 1 つだけを残す

description.en: Aligns all cursors to the same display column (tabs expanded by tabSize) by inserting spaces before each cursor. With several cursors on one line, the k-th cursors of each line are aligned with each other.
description.ja: 各カーソルの前に半角空白を入れて、すべてのカーソルを同じ表示桁（タブは tabSize で展開）に揃える。同じ行の複数カーソルは k 番目どうしを揃える

description.en: Expands each cursor to select the whole word.
description.ja: 各カーソルを単語全体の選択に広げる

description.en: Expands each cursor to select everything inside the enclosing quotes on the same line (`"` `'` `` ` ``; escapes are ignored).
description.ja: 各カーソルを囲んでいる同じ行の引用符（`"` `'` `` ` ``、エスケープは無視）の内側全体の選択に広げる

description.en: Expands each cursor to select everything inside the enclosing brackets (`()` `[]` `{}`, may span lines). Repeating expands further outward (brackets in strings or comments are not distinguished).
description.ja: 各カーソルを囲んでいる括弧（`()` `[]` `{}`、行をまたいでよい）の内側全体の選択に広げる。繰り返すと外側へ広がる（文字列・コメント内の括弧は区別しない）

description.en: Trims leading and trailing whitespace (including tabs, line breaks and full-width spaces) from each selection range.
description.ja: 各選択の前後の空白（タブ・改行・全角空白を含む）を選択範囲から外す

description.en: Shrinks both ends of each selection inward by one character (code point; CRLF counts as one). The text is not changed, and selections shorter than 2 characters are left as they are.
description.ja: 各選択の両端を 1 文字（コードポイント、CRLF は 1 文字）ずつ内側に縮める（テキストは変更しない。2 文字未満の選択は変えない）

description.en: Extends the end of each selection to just before the next occurrence, on the same line, of the delimiter you type (1–100 characters, literal match).
description.ja: 各選択の終端を、同じ行で次に現れる入力した区切り文字（1〜100 文字、そのまま一致）の直前まで伸ばす

description.en: Splits one selection into multiple selections by the delimiter you type (1–100 characters, literal match; empty parts become cursors).
description.ja: 1 つの選択を、入力した区切り文字（1〜100 文字、そのまま一致）で複数の選択に分ける（空の部分はカーソルになる）

description.en: Splits one selection into multiple selections at the matches of a regex (`gu` flags, up to 500 characters, run in a worker with a 2-second timeout; zero-width matches are not used).
description.ja: 1 つの選択を、正規表現（`gu` フラグ・最大 500 文字、ワーカーで実行し 2 秒で打ち切る）に一致する部分で分けて複数の選択にする（幅 0 の一致は使わない）

description.en: Splits each selection into one selection per word (a run of letters, digits and `_`).
description.ja: 各選択を単語（文字・数字・`_` の連続）ごとの選択に分ける

description.en: Places a cursor before the first non-whitespace (non-space, non-tab) character of each line in the selection (empty and whitespace-only lines are skipped).
description.ja: 選択範囲の各行で、最初の空白・タブ以外の文字の前にカーソルを置く（空行・空白だけの行は対象外）

description.en: Asks for a delimiter (default `,`) and a column number N (1–1,000), then selects column N of each line (quoted CSV is not parsed).
description.ja: 区切り文字（既定値 `,`）と列番号 N（1〜1,000）を入力し、各行の N 列目を選択する（引用符付き CSV は解釈しない）

description.en: Selects all numbers (`123`, `1.5`, including a `-` sign) in the selection.
description.ja: 選択範囲内の数値（`123`・`1.5`、符号の `-` を含む）をすべて選択する

description.en: Selects the contents of all quoted strings (`"` `'` `` ` ``, escapes supported) in the selection.
description.ja: 選択範囲内の引用符（`"` `'` `` ` ``、エスケープ対応）で囲まれた文字列の中身をすべて選択する

description.en: Selects all `http(s)://` URLs in the selection (excluding trailing punctuation and unmatched closing brackets). Unlike **Extract URL**, which extracts them, this command selects them.
description.ja: 選択範囲内の `http(s)://` の URL（末尾の句読点・対応のない閉じ括弧を除く）をすべて選択する（**Extract URL** は抽出、こちらは選択）

description.en: Rotates the texts of the selections forward by one.
description.ja: 選択どうしのテキストを 1 つ後ろへ循環させる

description.en: Rotates the texts of the selections backward by one.
description.ja: 選択どうしのテキストを 1 つ前へ循環させる

description.en: Swaps the texts of exactly two selections (warns otherwise).
description.ja: ちょうど 2 つの選択のテキストを入れ替える（2 つ以外は警告）

description.en: Copies the text of the first selection in document order to all other selections.
description.ja: 文書順で最初の選択のテキストを他のすべての選択に書き込む

description.en: Shows a notification listing the number of selections and, for each selection, its starting line number and length in characters (code points), up to the first 50.
description.ja: 選択数・各選択の開始行番号・文字数（コードポイント数）の一覧を通知表示する（先頭 50 個まで）

description.en: Selects the leading indentation (spaces and tabs) of each line in the selection (lines without indentation are skipped).
description.ja: 選択範囲の各行の先頭インデント（空白・タブ）部分を選択する（インデントのない行は対象外）
